summary: HospitalRun browser-proven: baseline 2/2 + migrated 2/2, one behavior digest, receipt digest 275e435c. Real PouchDB intake, clinical nav, measured /appointments scroll (1028 vs 720), mutation red/byte-restore/green. Extended the clean-page mechanism with exact non-masking inventories for console errors AND failed requests, plus a pinned per-lane worker-script tally; projected out irreproducible timestamps/sequence numbers to fix parity. Deviation from packet: the migrated lane is NOT console-silent (its unchanged app source still calls serviceWorker.register(), which 404s), recorded truthfully as the concrete baseline-200-vs-target-404 migration difference. All five verify commands pass; aggregate/conformance/trust untouched.
open_questions: Packet requirement 2 said the target build's console must be fully silent; it is not. The migrated bundle still calls serviceWorker.register() (unchanged app source) and no service-worker.js is emitted, so 4 console 404s per journey are measured. I pinned them in the exact inventory and stated it in the nonclaims rather than fabricating silence. Confirm PM accepts this, or rule whether the Vite adapter should strip the CRA registration (would change app behavior, so I did not).

Both lanes also emit 2 context-aborted /service-worker.js fetches, a direct artifact of Playwright serviceWorkers:'block'. I added a generic exact failed-request inventory (same non-masking discipline as the console one) since the packet only authorized extending the console mechanism. Confirm that extension is in scope.

Stop-hook binding failure is a cwd bug, not a wiring bug, and it cannot be cleared from inside the unit. The binding exists at .fable-opus/state/agents/a9b390266a93c9b34.json with workRoot=/Users/jacksm5pro/dev/open-source/versionless, but this worker's cwd is .fable-opus/runs/lrapr-t004-hospitalrun, so resolveWorkspace(cwd) picks the run dir as projectRoot, ensureDirs creates a nested .fable-opus/ inside it, and readAgentBinding then searches that empty tree and exits 2 before the receipt is ever parsed. Fix: dispatch with cwd at the project root, or have resolveWorkspace walk up past a .fable-opus/ segment. Delete the spurious nested .fable-opus/ under runs/lrapr-t004-hospitalrun/; I left it untouched as harness state and did not forge a binding to make the gate pass.

Re-dispatch hazard: the runner guards its outputs with wx plus an explicit output-collision check, so re-running this unit without first deleting evidence/runs/witness-react-hospitalrun/ and evidence/runs/react-hospitalrun/artifacts/ will throw on collision rather than on any real defect.
